OfflineVisibilityInfo: When the “Hide Online Status” feature is enabled, your online status will not be completely hidden. Instead, it reduces how often you appear as online. You may still appear online when interacting with the app, such as sending messages, reacting to them, or reading messages. Your status will return to offline after about 30–60 seconds. For the best result, it is recommended to enable all Ghost Mode options.
QuranNotification:
The Holy Quran has been activated. It is the sacred book of Islam and one of the main sources of legislation and guidance for Muslims. The Quran is recited in acts of worship such as prayer, and listening to it is considered an important practice among Muslims due to its spiritual and reflective meanings.

Some studies have shown that listening to the recitation of the Quran may help reduce stress and improve feelings of calmness and relaxation. This is attributed to the regular rhythm of the recitation and the soothing tone of the voice, producing an effect similar to listening to calming sounds or soft music from a psychological perspective.
